candidates.name: Acute Coronary Syndrome
support_spans: progressive shortness of breath for one day duration, accompanied by chest tightness and non-radiating retrosternal chest pain
Serial Troponin-T measurements showed progressive elevation, reaching 1101 ng/L on day 4
Sinus tachycardia with mildly elevated ST-segments at the inferior leads
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and laboratory results are consistent with acute coronary syndrome.

candidates.name: Thymic Carcinoma
support_spans: Right anterior mediastinal mass, well demarcated with minimal contact with surrounding great vessels and no adjoining abnormal lymph nodes
Epithelial malignancy of thymic origin, showing ovoid-to spindle neoplastic cells with nuclear atypia and mitosis
candidates.why: The presence of a thymic mass and biopsy results indicating epithelial malignancy of thymic origin support this diagnosis.

support_spans: Bilateral fine reticular opacities, widened mediastinum, cardiomegaly, and bilateral blunted costophrenic angles
Breathing sounds were bilaterally coarse upon auscultation
oxygen saturation of 68% under ambient air
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging results are consistent with pulmonary edema.
